output.summary: Cactus-like succulent tree native to central India, Odisha and southern India’s Deccan. It has spreading, nearly five-sided branches, thorns and thick, spoon-shaped leaves. The leaves are eaten raw or cooked, including boiled with syrup or chopped as stuffing in parts of the Philippines, while the latex is irritating and toxic.
